clause_name: RLA-460 — Residential Lease — Move-Out and Obligation to Vacate
library_question: Do the standard surrender-condition and obligation-to-vacate rules apply at tenancy end?

blocks.text: At move-out, Tenant must return the Premises clean, empty, undamaged beyond ordinary wear and tear, free of trash and personal property, with all keys/access devices returned, utilities maintained through surrender, and forwarding address provided. Tenant is responsible for cleaning, hauling, repairs, missing items, damages, unpaid amounts, and other lawful charges.

If Tenant gives a valid notice to vacate or Landlord gives a valid notice of nonrenewal or termination, Tenant must vacate on or before the stated date unless Landlord gives written consent to remain. Tenant may not unilaterally extend the move-out date.
